next_step: POC perf run with 3M-doc index + reranker; legal to sign DPA
notes:
- Background: regional mid-size health system plus affiliated specialist clinics. Heavy PHI: discharge summaries, progress notes, imaging reports.
- Primary ask: enterprise search + RAG for clinician workflow (fast retrieval + high-precision rerank). Want explainability on source snippets, line-level provenance.
- Quote from CTO: "We can't tolerate hallucinations on care notes — precision > 98% required for reranked top-3." 
- Technical wishlist: keep raw documents inside VPC/air-gapped on-prem instance; vector store that supports sharding across warm/cold tiers; reranker GPU path with async fallback to smaller model during load spikes.
- Indexing: initial pilot 3M docs, expect 20–30M within 12 months. Need incremental indexing (daily delta ingest ~100k docs).
- Perf/cost: target p95 end-to-end <300ms; target cost <$0.005/q at scale (200 qps sustained). Open to batching at gateway but cannot add >50ms tail.
- Security: SSO (SAML), SCIM, enterprise KMS, immutable audit logs per-request, DLP scanning in ingest pipeline. Must pass SOC2 + ISO27001 + local data residency rules (state-level). 
- Vendor fit: leaning toward vendors who offer private control plane + deployment inside our Azure VNet. Interested in Redwood Private but open to Dedicated if migration path clear.
- Concerns raised by security team: third-party backups, telemetry payloads, exception telemetry that may include PHI.
- Legal: DPA template needed; privacy counsel flagged data residency clause.
- POC plan (agreed): 2-week perf sweep. Deliverables: embedding batch of 3M docs, vector index (ann), reranker evaluation on 2k clinical queries, latency/cost dashboard.
- AE notes: short, choppy: "POC kickoff 2026-03-10, SE running perf scripts, legal reviewing DPA, security to send questionnaire on 2026-03-08."
